points.title: 贵族童年
points.description: 马可·奥勒留出生于罗马一个显赫的贵族家庭，他的父亲是前执政官，祖父曾任罗马市长。尽管出身显赫，马可从小接受严格而朴素的斯多葛主义教育。他被皇帝哈德良选中作为继承人，并与未来的皇帝安敦尼·庇护的女儿福斯蒂娜订婚。这段时期，他师从著名学者学习修辞学、法律和哲学，特别是斯多葛学派思想，为他后来的统治和哲学思想奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Marcus Aurelius was born into a prominent noble family in Rome; his father was a former consul and his grandfather had served as mayor of Rome. Despite his noble birth, Marcus received a strict and simple Stoic education. He was selected by Emperor Hadrian as a successor and engaged to Faustina, daughter of the future Emperor Antoninus Pius. During this period, he studied rhetoric, law, and philosophy under renowned scholars, particularly Stoic thought, which laid the foundation for his later reign and philosophical ideas.

points.title: 继承人培养
points.description: 在安敦尼·庇护成为皇帝后，马可被正式收为养子并指定为继承人。这一时期，马可积极参与帝国政务，担任执政官等重要职务，同时继续深入研究哲学。他开始撰写《沉思录》的早期内容，记录自己的哲学思考和对统治的反思。尽管被培养为皇帝，马可仍保持着简朴的生活方式，注重道德修养，并展现出对斯多葛哲学的坚定信仰。这段经历塑造了他作为统治者的核心特质：责任感、自律和对公共利益的关注。
points.descriptionEn: After Antoninus Pius became emperor, Marcus was formally adopted as his son and designated as successor. During this period, Marcus actively participated in imperial affairs, holding important positions such as consul, while continuing to study philosophy deeply. He began writing the early parts of his Meditations, recording his philosophical reflections and thoughts on governance. Despite being trained as an emperor, Marcus maintained a simple lifestyle, focused on moral cultivation, and demonstrated a firm commitment to Stoic philosophy. This experience shaped his core traits as a ruler: sense of duty, self-discipline, and concern for the public good.

points.title: 边境战争
points.description: 161年，安敦尼·庇去世后，马可与养弟维鲁斯共同成为皇帝，开创了罗马帝国首次双皇帝共治。然而，帝国随即面临严重危机：东方帕提亚帝国入侵，北方蛮族部落不断骚扰边境。马可亲自率军多次远征，包括在东方与帕提亚的战争和在北方与日耳曼部落的战争。尽管军事上取得了一定胜利，但战争消耗了大量资源，加剧了帝国的财政困难。这段经历使马可深刻体会到战争的残酷和帝国的脆弱，也促使他更加注重军事改革和边境防御，同时继续在军营中撰写《沉思录》。
points.descriptionEn: In 161, after the death of Antoninus Pius, Marcus became emperor alongside his adoptive brother Verus, establishing the first dual emperorship in Roman history. However, the empire immediately faced severe crises: the Parthian Empire invaded from the east, and northern barbarian tribes constantly harassed the frontiers. Marcus personally led several military campaigns, including wars against Parthia in the east and against Germanic tribes in the north. Although achieving some military victories, the wars consumed vast resources and exacerbated the empire's financial difficulties. This experience deeply impressed Marcus with the cruelty of war and the fragility of the empire, prompting him to focus more on military reforms and border defenses while continuing to write his Meditations in military camps.

points.title: 瘟疫与危机
points.description: 169年，维鲁斯皇帝去世后，马可成为唯一的统治者。此时，一场毁灭性的安东尼瘟疫席卷帝国，造成大量人口死亡，严重削弱了帝国实力。同时，北方边境的日耳曼部落威胁加剧，马可不得不多次亲征。面对多重危机，马可展现出非凡的领导力和坚韧品质，他亲自处理政务，改革税收制度，加强边境防御，并努力恢复经济。在繁忙的政务和军事活动中，他继续完善《沉思录》，这部作品成为斯多葛哲学的代表作，对后世产生了深远影响。180年，马可·奥勒留在维也纳附近的军营中因病去世，结束了其充满挑战的统治。
points.descriptionEn: In 169, after the death of Emperor Verus, Marcus became the sole ruler of the empire. At this time, the devastating Antonine Plague swept across the empire, causing massive population loss and severely weakening Roman power. Meanwhile, threats from northern Germanic tribes intensified, forcing Marcus to lead multiple campaigns personally. Facing multiple crises, Marcus demonstrated extraordinary leadership and resilience, personally handling state affairs, reforming the tax system, strengthening border defenses, and working to restore the economy. Amidst busy political and military activities, he continued to refine his Meditations, which became a masterpiece of Stoic philosophy and had a profound impact on later generations. In 180, Marcus Aurelius died of illness in a military camp near Vienna, ending his challenging reign.

supporter.zh: 马可·奥勒留被视为罗马帝国最伟大的哲学家皇帝之一，他的斯多葛哲学思想和对道德的坚守使他成为理想统治者的典范。他在位期间面对战争、瘟疫和帝国危机时展现出的坚韧、责任感和智慧，体现了斯多葛学派的核心价值观。他的《沉思录》作为个人哲学思考的结晶，成为后世无数人的精神指南，影响跨越时空，被誉为西方哲学史上最重要的个人著作之一。
supporter.en: Marcus Aurelius is regarded as one of the greatest philosopher-emperors of the Roman Empire. His Stoic philosophy and commitment to moral principles made him a model of ideal rulership. During his reign, he demonstrated remarkable resilience, sense of duty, and wisdom in the face of wars, plagues, and imperial crises, embodying the core values of Stoicism. His Meditations, as a collection of personal philosophical reflections, became a spiritual guide for countless generations across time and space, hailed as one of the most important personal works in the history of Western philosophy.

critic.zh: 批评者认为马可·奥勒留的统治未能有效解决罗马帝国的根本问题。尽管他个人品德高尚，但他的军事政策消耗了大量资源，未能阻止帝国边境的持续威胁。作为斯多葛哲学家，他被批评为过于接受命运而缺乏变革精神，未能阻止帝国走向衰落的趋势。此外，他对基督教的态度虽然相对宽容，但未能真正理解这一新兴宗教的潜力，错失了可能改变帝国文化格局的机会。他的统治时期被视为帝国由盛转衰的关键节点。
critic.en: Critics argue that Marcus Aurelius' rule failed to effectively address the fundamental problems of the Roman Empire. Despite his personal virtue, his military policies consumed vast resources without stopping the persistent threats to the empire's borders. As a Stoic philosopher, he is criticized for being too accepting of fate and lacking reformist spirit, unable to prevent the empire's decline. Additionally, while his attitude toward Christianity was relatively tolerant, he failed to truly understand the potential of this emerging religion, missing opportunities that might have changed the empire's cultural landscape. His reign is seen as a critical turning point in the empire's transition from prosperity to decline.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，马可·奥勒留被复杂地定义为一个矛盾的统一体——既是强大的统治者，又是沉思的哲学家；既是斯多葛理想的践行者，又是面对现实困境的实用主义者。他的形象超越了单纯的帝王或哲学家，成为人类面对逆境时的精神象征。在当代，他的《沉思录》被广泛阅读和应用，其思想影响了从政治领袖到普通人的各个层面。马可·奥勒留的生平和作品体现了古典哲学与实际政治的交汇，成为连接古代智慧与现代思考的重要桥梁。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Marcus Aurelius is complexly defined as a paradoxical unity—both a powerful ruler and a contemplative philosopher; both a practitioner of Stoic ideals and a pragmatist facing real-world dilemmas. His image transcends mere emperor or philosopher, becoming a spiritual symbol for humanity facing adversity. Today, his Meditations are widely read and applied, influencing various levels from political leaders to ordinary people. Marcus Aurelius' life and work embody the intersection of classical philosophy and practical politics, serving as an important bridge connecting ancient wisdom with modern thought.

self.zh: 当你清晨不愿起床时，想一想，你是为了人类的利益而工作。
self.en: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive—to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.

others.zh: 马可·奥勒留是罗马帝国最后一位伟大的皇帝，他的统治标志着古典时代的终结。
others.en: Marcus Aurelius was the last of the great emperors of Rome; his reign marked the end of the classical era.
